title: IMD forecasts heavy rain in Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram & Tripura today - News On AIR
article_text: India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places over Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura during the day. Bihar, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Punjab, Tamil Nadu Puducherry, Karaikal and Uttar Pradesh will experience thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds for the day. According to IMD, isolated to scattered rainfall over East Madhya Pradesh till 9th and Chhattisgarh till 10th of this month.
